findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is still abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The class body was reduced to `pass`, but `StatefulDetectorHandler` now declares `build_occurrence_and_event_data` as an abstract method, and this PR also makes `evaluate_group_key_value` call it. `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` does not implement it, so it stays abstract. `Detector.detector_handler` then calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, which raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. Any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` will crash when evaluated. The handler needs an implementation of `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`, or the abstract requirements need to be relaxed.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` says it 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`', but the signature and implementation now return a dict keyed by group key. Callers and implementers reading the docs will expect the old list contract.

findings.title: Duplicate group key detection and its error log were removed silently
findings.body: Keying results by group key means duplicates are now overwritten inside `evaluate` (`results[result.group_key] = result`) rather than detected. The previous `logger.error('Duplicate detector state group keys found')` path is gone, so a handler that produces the same group key twice in one packet now loses one result with no log or metric. This is a loss of observability that the PR description does not mention.
